package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/testhelper"
)

// This consumer exercises every exported identifier of the library so the
// strict production deadcode pass sees the whole public surface as reachable.
func main() {
	portal := problem.ErrorPortal{
		Scheme: "https", Host: "docs.example.atomi.cloud",
		Landscape: "raichu", Platform: "go", Service: "user", Module: "api",
	}
	_ = problem.LocalErrorPortal()

	uri, uriErr := problem.TypeURI(portal, "v1", "entity-not-found")
	if uriErr != nil {
		var segmentErr *problem.InvalidSegmentError
		if errors.As(uriErr, &segmentErr) {
			fmt.Println(segmentErr.Error())
		}
	}

	envelope := problem.Problem{Type: uri, Title: "Entity not found", Status: 404, Detail: new("d"), Instance: new("/i"), Recoverable: false, Data: map[string]any{"resource": "user"}}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	var decoded problem.Problem
	_ = json.Unmarshal(encoded, &decoded)
	_, _ = envelope.MarshalJSON()
	_ = decoded.UnmarshalJSON(encoded)
	_ = envelope.Equal(decoded)
	fmt.Println(envelope.String())
	fmt.Println(problem.UncataloguedProblemID)

	registry, regErr := problem.NewRegistry(portal)
	if regErr != nil {
		var dupErr *problem.DuplicateTypeError
		_ = errors.As(regErr, &dupErr)
	}
	_ = registry.Portal()
	_ = registry.Register(problem.EntityNotFound())
	_, _ = registry.Lookup("entity-not-found")
	if _, reqErr := registry.Require("missing"); reqErr != nil {
		var unknownErr *problem.UnknownTypeError
		if errors.As(reqErr, &unknownErr) {
			fmt.Println(unknownErr.Error())
		}
	}
	_ = registry.Entries()
	_, _ = registry.TypeURIFor(problem.EntityNotFound())
	_ = problem.RegisterGenerics(registry)

	_ = problem.GenericProblems()
	_ = problem.ValidationError()
	_ = problem.EntityNotFound()
	_ = problem.Conflict()
	_ = problem.Unauthenticated()
	_ = problem.Unauthorized()
	_ = problem.InvalidJSON()

	catalog := problem.NewCatalog(portal)
	_ = catalog.Portal()
	catalog.Add(problem.CatalogEntry{ID: "x", TypeURI: uri, Title: "X", Status: 500})
	_ = catalog.AddType(problem.EntityNotFound(), problem.CatalogEndpoint{Method: "GET", Path: "/user"})
	_ = catalog.AddGenerics()
	_, _ = catalog.Lookup("x")
	_ = catalog.Entries()
	_ = catalog.ToCRDContent()
	_ = problem.CatalogEndpoint{Method: "GET", Path: "/user"}.ToContent()
	_ = problem.CatalogEntry{ID: "x"}.ToCRDContent()

	problemErr := problem.NewError(envelope)
	wrapped := problem.WrapError(envelope, errors.New("cause"))
	fmt.Println(problemErr.Error(), wrapped.Error())
	_ = problemErr.Unwrap()

	options := problem.DefaultTransformOptions()
	options.Registry = registry
	_ = problem.FromObject(errors.New("boom"), options)

	local := problem.NewLocalError(problem.NoopErrorSink{})
	local = problem.NewLocalErrorWithPortal(problem.NoopErrorSink{}, portal)
	_, _ = local.Wrap(context.Background(), errors.New("boom"), "stack")
	var sink problem.ErrorSink = problem.NoopErrorSink{}
	_ = sink.Capture(context.Background(), envelope)

	sample := testhelper.SampleProblem()
	_ = testhelper.SampleErrorPortal()
	_ = testhelper.CheckProblem(sample,
		testhelper.ExpectType(sample.Type),
		testhelper.ExpectID("entity-not-found"),
		testhelper.ExpectTitle(sample.Title),
		testhelper.ExpectStatus(sample.Status),
		testhelper.ExpectRecoverable(sample.Recoverable),
		testhelper.ExpectDetail("d"),
		testhelper.ExpectInstance("/i"),
		testhelper.ExpectData(sample.Data),
	)
	reporter := deadcodeReporter{}
	testhelper.AssertProblem(reporter, sample, testhelper.ExpectStatus(404))
	_, _ = testhelper.CheckError(problemErr)
	_ = testhelper.AssertError(reporter, problemErr)
}

type deadcodeReporter struct{}

func (deadcodeReporter) Helper() {}

func (deadcodeReporter) Fatalf(string, ...any) {}
